method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; a seat-neutral core (ohs-core.l4), date helpers (ohs-dates.l4, prelude only, no daydate import, no YMD) and a seat layer (ohs-seat.l4) that restates no rule; two regulative rules (s 38(3), s 131(2)/(2A)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

Not deposited and asked as facts or left in penalty units: the regulations, the compliance codes, the value of a penalty unit.
